name: g003 console.log of errors with own props, cause chain and nested containers
source: function main(): void { const inner = new RangeError("deep") as any; inner.stack = "RangeError: deep"; const e = new Error("wrap", { cause: inner }) as any; e.stack = "Error: wrap"; e.code = "E_X"; console.log(e); console.log({ e }); console.log([e]); }
